title: Items, Crafts & World of the Realms of Runeterra
description: This project introduces all the items, blocks, abilities and other gameplay mechanics not related to the world generation provided by the Core Package of Realms of Runeterra: A Tale of Relative Dimensions
body:
This Content Pack for the Realms Of Runeterra will include items, from hextech gems to Caitlyn's rifle, Ezreal's gauntlet, and some other related items that might grant minor buffs like the Rod of Ages, or Guinsoo's Rageblade, and decoration and building blocks from different places in Runeterra and any other stuff not related to the core package which manages generation of the Runeterra Dimension.

---

From version 0.1a.8 onwards, the mod Realms of Runeterra is split in three:
- Core: Everything related to the generation of the Runeterra dimension
- Content (this mod): Everything related to blocks, items and gameplay mecahnics
- Misc: Other systems that aren't on the other two categories.

This way, if you want to use any item block or play as a champion on the rift you don't need to download all the dimension generation logic, which is the heavy part of the mod!

Conversely, if you want the full experience including the dimension, you need to download all the parts.


To download the core package this mod is a dependency of, go [here](https://modrinth.com/mod/realms-of-runeterra)
